blocks.text: Goal: make the five basic force parts. Every other part of the suit and the board is built up from them, so the chapter starts here. All five use the same layout: one material in the four corners, one on the four edges and one in the middle; each craft makes 4.

Where the materials come from: Demonic Plates and Demonic Cores in [[demons/ackronite]], Wind Crystals in [[wind/wind_gem]], Mithriline Crystals in [[mithriline/mithriline_ingot]], Fading Crystals in [[pentacle/pale_crystal_pillar]], MRU Resonating Crystals in [[alloys/resonating_crystal]], Pale Plates in [[alloys/pale]]; MRU Reactors only come from relic chests in Hoanna ([[hoanna/relics]]).

blocks.title: Save them
blocks.text: Each Force Field Core craft eats one MRU Reactor. The whole suit plus the board needs 5 Force Field Core crafts, i.e. exactly 5 reactors: keep them for this.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You have any one of the five.

Goal: build a {item:essentialcraft5:force_field_generator} and {item:essentialcraft5:force_field_plating} from the basic parts. Every piece of the suit needs one generator and 2 or 3 platings; the board needs a generator too.

rows: Force Emitters in the corners, Force Field Cores on the edges, a {item:essentialcraft5:matter_of_eternity} in the middle; <t>2</t> per craft
Particle Catchers in the corners, Particle Emitters on the edges, a Force Field Core in the middle; <t>2</t> per craft

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: <w>Any MRU stored in the Matter of Eternity is lost with it</w>, so drain it first. The whole suit plus the board needs 3 generator crafts, i.e. 3 Matters of Eternity ([[storage/soul_storage]]).

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You have a Force Field Generator.

title: Stabilizers, Repulsion and Thrust
summary: Pressure Stabilizer, Repulsion Generator, Thruster Engine

blocks.text: Goal: make a {item:essentialcraft5:thruster_engine}. It needs {item:essentialcraft5:pressure_stabilizer}s, and while you are at it make a {item:essentialcraft5:repulsion_generator} too: the chestplate, the leggings and the board need them, and every piece of the suit needs stabilizers.

rows: Force Absorbers in the corners, Neuronic Enriched Plating in the five cross slots; <t>2</t> per craft
Particle Emitters in the corners, Force Emitters on the edges, Neuronic Enriched Plating in the middle; <t>2</t> per craft
4 Force Emitters, a Particle Emitter, 2 Pressure Stabilizers and 2 Neuronic Enriched Platings (see the grid above); <t>2</t> per craft

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You have a Thruster Engine.

title: Sound and Vision
summary: Sound Manager, Speaker Plate, Vision Lens

blocks.text: Goal: make the two things the helmet needs: {item:essentialcraft5:speaker_plate}s (a {item:essentialcraft5:sound_manager} first) and a {item:essentialcraft5:vision_lens}. The helmet takes 2 Speaker Plates and 1 Vision Lens; nothing else uses these three.

rows: 4 Demonic Plates, 2 Demonic Cores, 2 Force Absorbers and a Pressure Stabilizer in the middle; <t>1</t> per craft
Force Absorbers in the corners, Neuronic Enriched Plating on the edges, a Sound Manager in the middle; <t>1</t> per craft

Neuronic Enriched Plating in the corners, Force Absorbers top and bottom, {item:essentialcraft5:sun_imbued_glass} left and right, {item:essentialcraft5:magic_purified_glass_alloy} in the middle; <t>1</t> per craft

blocks.text: In later releases of the original mod the recipes for the Vision Lens, the chestplate and the board were copied wrong (the lens took the Force Field Core's ingredients), so the suit could not be made at all. This port uses the recipes from the earlier code.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You have a Speaker Plate.

title: {item:essentialcraft5:computer_engine}
summary: The computer that runs the Demonic Plates

blocks.text: Goal: make the {item:essentialcraft5:computer_engine}: it is the "computer to control the Demonic Plates" from the start of the hologram chapter. The chestplate needs one.

You need: a {item:essentialcraft5:logic_core} (below), one of each of the four math cores (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division; dropped by the Holographic Projection, see [[hologram/math_cores]]) and 4 Neuronic Enriched Platings.

rows: Demonic Plates in the corners, {item:minecraft:redstone} top and bottom, {item:minecraft:lapis_lazuli} left and right, {item:minecraft:quartz} in the middle; <t>1</t> per craft
Neuronic Enriched Plating in the corners; Addition Core on top, Subtraction Core below, Division Core left, Multiplication Core right; the Logic Core in the middle

blocks.title: The four cores
blocks.text: You only need one of each; math cores have no recipe and no other use.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You have the Computer Engine.

title: Computer Guy's Suit
summary: The last step of the main line

blocks.text: Goal: make the {item:essentialcraft5:computer_helmet}, {item:essentialcraft5:computer_chestplate}, {item:essentialcraft5:computer_leggings} and {item:essentialcraft5:computer_boots} and have all four on you at once (worn pieces count). This is the last step of the main line.

Every piece needs a Force Field Generator, Force Field Plating, Neuronic Enriched Plating and Pressure Stabilizers; the helmet also takes 2 Speaker Plates and the Vision Lens, the chestplate the Computer Engine, a Repulsion Generator and a Thruster Engine, the leggings a Repulsion Generator and 2 Thruster Engines. They come out empty: charge them in a [[storage/charging_chamber]].
Armor

rows: +{cfg:general.computer_armor.max_health} each for the helmet, leggings and boots, +{cfg:general.computer_armor.chestplate_max_health} for the chestplate
16384, never lost while you wear it

blocks.text: These stats are always there, charged or not. Whatever the full set adds above the game's caps (armor <t>30</t>, toughness <t>20</t>) does not count. Taking a piece off removes its extra max health, and your health drops with it.
Blocking damage while charged

Each piece holds {cfg:general.computer_armor.max_mru} MRU (shown in its tooltip). A charged piece blocks its share of a hit: helmet 3/20, chestplate 8/20, leggings 6/20, boots 3/20; with all four charged the whole hit is blocked and you lose no health (knockback still happens).

It blocks melee, projectiles such as arrows, and fire, lava, explosions and lightning (the purple first line of the tooltip says what it blocks). Magic (including splash potions of harming thrown at you), orbital strikes and damage that ignores armor (burning, freezing in powder snow, drowning) are not blocked and cost no MRU; your armor reduces them as usual.

Blocking costs MRU per piece: {cfg:general.computer_armor.mru_per_damage} MRU for each point of its share, rounded down, at least 1 point. It is paid from storage items you carry ({item:essentialcraft5:soul_shard} and the like) first, then from the piece itself. <w>A piece that cannot pay does not block that hit</w>, and you take its share; a piece with no MRU at all never blocks.

rows: helmet 1 + chestplate 3 + leggings 2 + boots 1 points, {cfg:general.computer_armor.mru_per_damage|mul:7} MRU in total

blocks.text: While you carry the {item:essentialcraft5:infinite_mru_crystal} it pays for everything, so the suit never runs dry.
What each piece does

cells: You never run out of air and your hunger bar stays full (you regenerate as fast as when well fed); press {keybind:key.essentialcraft5.computer_armor_night_vision} to toggle night vision; you can see MRU clusters through walls

You never run out of air and your hunger and saturation stay full (fast regeneration); press {keybind:key.essentialcraft5.computer_armor_night_vision} to toggle night vision; you can see MRU clusters through walls

rows: Immune to magic, wither and starvation damage (harming potions you drink and poison count as magic); splash potions of harming thrown by others still hurt
You move faster (speed +{cfg:general.computer_armor.leggings_speed}) and jump higher; while burning you get 5 seconds of Fire Resistance every second
No fall damage; you step straight up full blocks

blocks.text: Full set

items.text: When something hurts you, {cfg:general.computer_armor.thorns_ratio|pct} of the hit goes back to the attacker as thorns damage (even if the suit blocked the whole hit; nothing under 0.5 points; thorns damage is never returned again);

items: press {keybind:key.essentialcraft5.computer_armor_boost} to boost toward where you are looking, with a {cfg:general.computer_armor.dash_cooldown|sec} cooldown; not while riding or sleeping;

blocks.text: Two small circles at the top of the screen: night vision on the left (lit = on), the boost on the right (the missing slice is the cooldown left). The full set also makes you immune to MRU corruption and radiation.

blocks.title: What gets through
blocks.text: The suit does not stop: magic (splash potions of harming thrown at you); the Holographic Projection's divider fields (they halve your health outright; divider shots fired by players never hit players); damage that ignores armor; and orbital strikes, which are neither physical nor elemental.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: All four pieces on you at once completes the advancement "Fully Geared Nerd". That is the end of the main line.

title: {item:essentialcraft5:computer_board}
summary: Wear it on your belt and fly

blocks.text: Goal (optional): make a {item:essentialcraft5:computer_board}. Worn in the belt slot of your accessory bar it lets you fly like in creative mode. It needs neither the suit nor MRU.

rows: belt; only one counts at a time

blocks.text: A board appears under your feet while you fly. Take it off and the flight it gives is gone; flight from anything else is left alone.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: You cannot fly while fighting the Holographic Projection ([[hologram/summoning]]).
The original research book promised "incredible speed while you are flying": back then it made you four times as fast as creative flight.

title: What the whole suit costs
summary: Total materials for the suit and board

blocks.text: The Computer Guy's Suit is the most expensive thing in the mod. Below are the totals with every part expanded and everything made together: leftovers from one craft go into the next piece, so this is a little cheaper than adding up the pieces one by one.

Demonic Plates come from Ackronite traded from demons ([[demons/trade]]): each trade gives {cfg:general.demon.reward_min}-{cfg:general.demon.reward_max} ingots and 4 ingots make 4 plates, so 329 plates means 329 ingots. Imbuing 55 Wind Crystals costs {cfg:general.wind.gem_espe|mul:55} ESPE in total and is the slowest part.

blocks.title: Imbue faster
blocks.text: Crystal pillars in the End gather {cfg:machines.mithriline_crystal_pillar.espe_generated_end} ESPE per tick ({cfg:machines.mithriline_crystal_pillar.espe_generated} in the Overworld), so a Wind Rune built in the End is much faster; build several runes and imbue in parallel ([[wind/wind_rune]]).
